essence: The previously mentioned food-offering should be offered in a golden vessel.
Afterwards, one should arrange an oblation mixed with sugar and ghee.
The oblation is considered to be placed beginning from in front of the deity along the leftward path.
One should worship while muttering the mantra either a thousand times or one hundred and eight times.
The worshipper becomes adored by the gods and esteemed among all beings.
